## Overview The kernel works on gfx950 and is a drop in replacement for fp8_mqa_logits (that's gluon), see [docstring](https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/blob/e6ded2168ef43111c57d591dd310eccdfc27aaf1/aiter/ops/flydsl/fp8_mqa_logits_kernels.py#L481). **Note**: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/60294 and https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/pull/6185 will fix so we don't have to manually select between the gluon and flydsl mqa_logits kernel here from vllm. However those are still wip, so I suggest we move fast and delete the current manual selection once those are merged. I suspect we'd want to use flydsl in most cases anyways ## Claims - 10-20% improved TTFT - 5-20% improved throughput at 64k+ ctx - Unaffected ITL (as expected) - Improvements growing with ctx len ## Validation ### 1. e2e sweep ```bash VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 \ VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_TRITON_SPARSE_MLA=1 \ VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FUSION_SHARED_EXPERTS=1 \ VLLM_USE_BREAKABLE_CUDAGRAPH=1 \ vllm serve zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash --tensor-parallel-size 8 --max-num-seqs 512 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.8 --attention-backend ROCM_AITER_MLA_SPARSE --max-num-batched-tokens 16384 --reasoning-parser glm47 ``` ```bash # always num_prompts=10*max_concurrency, num_warmups=2*max_concurrency vllm bench serve \ --backend vllm --model zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash \ --dataset_name random --random_input_len $ISL --random_output_len 1024 \ --max_concurrency 32 --num_prompts 320 --num_warmups 64 \ --host localhost --port 8000 --ignore_eos --seed 56552124 ``` | ISL | OSL | Conc | TTFT main (ms) | TTFT this branch (ms) | TTFT improv. | ITL main (ms) | ITL this branch (ms) | ITL improv. | Out tok/s main | Out tok/s this branch | Out tok/s improv. | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---| | 512k | 1k | 4 | 22731.18 | 17497.50 | **+23.02%** | 8.85 | 8.86 | **-0.16%** | 52.58 | 64.21 | **+22.11%** | | 512k | 1k | 1 | 17088.25 | 13562.26 | **+20.63%** | 7.84 | 7.88 | **-0.45%** | 40.79 | 47.36 | **+16.12%** | | 256k | 1k | 4 | 8520.00 | 7032.57 | **+17.46%** | 8.71 | 8.67 | **+0.43%** | 118.66 | 134.23 | **+13.12%** | | 256k | 1k | 1 | 6466.89 | 5497.06 | **+15.00%** | 7.69 | 7.74 | **-0.71%** | 71.43 | 76.29 | **+6.81%** | | 64k | 1k | 8 | 1688.92 | 1508.12 | **+10.71%** | 9.58 | 9.57 | **+0.03%** | 402.44 | 424.37 | **+5.45%** | | 64k | 1k | 1 | 1324.33 | 1220.67 | **+7.83%** | 7.66 | 7.72 | **-0.71%** | 111.72 | 112.33 | **+0.55%** | | 8k | 1k | 64 | 625.06 | 578.52 | **+7.45%** | 12.71 | 12.70 | **+0.01%** | 2783.20 | 2885.86 | **+3.69%** | | 8k | 1k | 8 | 357.72 | 314.99 | **+11.94%** | 9.55 | 9.58 | **-0.32%** | 737.42 | 745.27 | **+1.06%** | | 8k | 1k | 1 | 181.00 | 158.44 | **+12.47%** | 7.66 | 7.68 | **-0.24%** | 127.70 | 127.77 | **+0.05%** | | 1k | 1k | 64 | 453.38 | 454.44 | **-0.23%** | 12.54 | 12.54 | **+0.02%** | 4487.77 | 4482.36 | **-0.12%** | | 1k | 1k | 8 | 200.64 | 207.26 | **-3.30%** | 9.43 | 9.39 | **+0.39%** | 831.57 | 834.59 | **+0.36%** | | 1k | 1k | 1 | 98.71 | 94.26 | **+4.50%** | 7.54 | 7.48 | **+0.77%** | 131.04 | 132.11 | **+0.82%** | ### 2. Accuracy GPQA GSM8k ### 3. Microbenchmarks See AITER PR https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/pull/4538 ## Details ### Before At 512k ISL, the final chunk's indexer splits the context into **16** chunks and scores+topk's each of them individually. This happens for each of the **11** sparse MLA layers. These kernels execute in - mqa_logits: ~800us - indexer topk: 1.9ms Hence we spend `800us * 11 * 16 = 140ms` on topk only, The full forward takes 800ms, so 18% of chunked prefill is spent just computing indexer logits! ### After ---
